headline: Uganda Trade Deficit Widens as Business Confidence Hits Multi-Year Low
summary: Uganda's trade deficit reached $980.1 million in September, significantly exceeding the $280 million estimate. Simultaneously, business confidence fell to 53.5 in October, the lowest level since February 2023, citing challenges in credit access and hiring.
why: Trade balances and business confidence are key indicators of economic health in emerging markets, influencing foreign investment and currency stability.

impacts.name: Uganda
impacts.why: Weakening economic indicators suggest a slowdown in growth.
